label: v0.4.2 — Bid thread relabel to Nom / Forced Increase / Overtake
description: Drops the 'proxy walk' jargon. Bid thread now classifies each step from the observer's perspective: Nom (opening bid), Forced Increase (same franchise as previous high — MFL walked their hidden proxy), Overtake (different franchise dethroned the leader). Classification computed client-side by walking each per-lot thread chronologically.
